description: Trigger and behavior evals for compliance-gated research archival to jmresearch/research.

tests.prompt: Archive this study to the research repo — push the paper, data, and scripts. [paper + data attached]
grading_criteria: Skill triggers
Runs the compliance gate before anything is staged or pushed
Proposes a <topic>/<research-short-name> and asks the user to confirm/override
Lays out the folder with paper.md, data/, scripts/, LICENSE, ATTRIBUTIONS.md, COMPLIANCE.md, README.md
Shows a pre-push manifest and gets confirmation before pushing
Reports commit SHA + pushed path, and what was included vs referenced vs omitted

tests.prompt: Push this paper and its dataset to jmresearch/research. [dataset is under a no-redistribution DUA]
grading_criteria: Compliance gate classifies the dataset as not redistributable
Archives a reference-only stub (citation, URL, version, hash, retrieval steps) instead of the raw data
Records the disposition and the governing terms in ATTRIBUTIONS.md / COMPLIANCE.md
Does not push the raw restricted data

tests.prompt: Save this study and its data to the research repo. [data contains participant names and emails]
grading_criteria: Privacy screen detects PII
Blocks the push of the raw data (fail-closed)
Asks the user to de-identify, supply a compliant reference, or record an explicit attestation
Never scrubs/de-identifies the data automatically

tests.prompt: Archive this research; here's the data — not sure where it came from. [provenance/license unknown]
grading_criteria: Treats unknown license/provenance as unverified
Fail-closed: does not include the raw data without an explicit recorded override
Never reports the data as 'cleared'

tests.prompt: Push this paper to jmresearch/research. [assume gh is not authenticated]
grading_criteria: Detects gh is missing/unauthenticated during preflight
Stops and instructs the user to run gh auth login
Does not fabricate a successful push
Skill does not trigger
